Here's what I found, Dana:

---

**Figure available: No.** Walmart's R&D expense for the year ended 31 January 2025 is **not available** in the systems I can access.

### What I checked:

| Source | What I tried | Result |
|---|---|---|
| **XBRL snapshot (WMT)** | `list_available_concepts` — only `InventoryNet` and `CostOfRevenue` exist for WMT. | R&D not present |
| **XBRL concept lookups** | `ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense`, `ResearchAndDevelopment`, `ResearchExpense`, `DevelopmentExpense` — all returned "concept not in snapshot for this company." | None available |
| **XBRL frames** | `ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense` across all companies for FY2025 — "no facts for that concept/period in snapshot." | No cross-company data either |
| **SEC full-text search** | "research and development" and "Walmart research and development expense 2025" — zero hits. | Nothing |
| **Email** | Searched inbox for Walmart R&D correspondence — empty. | Nothing |
| **Docs / Sheets** | Searched policies and drive for R&D-related documents — none found. | Nothing |

Walmart does have a 10-K filed 2025-03-14 (accession 0000104169-25-000012), but the XBRL tag coverage in this snapshot is limited to `InventoryNet` ($56.4B) and `CostOfRevenue` ($511.8B). The R&D line item simply isn't tagged in the data we have.
